host.os: Windows 11 Home Insider Preview Single Language

embedded_target.wasm_incompatibility_reason: Xtensa LX106 architecture not supported by any production WASM runtime. Only 80 KB SRAM available — far below minimum requirements of known runtimes (WAMR interpreter requires ~100 KB+, Wasmtime/Wasmer require x86_64/aarch64).

gcc.action_required: Install MinGW-w64 or MSYS2 for native host benchmarks

clang.action_required: Install LLVM for wasm32-wasi compilation target

wasmtime.action_required: Install via winget or official installer

wasmer.action_required: Install via winget or official installer

wamr.action_required: Investigate feasibility of building iwasm on Windows

esp8266_build.notes: Phase 1 baseline firmware (blink + Serial info). WiFi library linked but disabled at runtime.
